diagnosed_limitations.title: Facility Doorway Costmap Halo Overlap
diagnosed_limitations.description: At inflation radius >= 0.32m, 0.85m doorways suffer from overlapping inflation cost halos, closing the free passage cross-section (<0.36m robot base).
diagnosed_limitations.resolution: Resolved in V2.6 via inflation_radius = 0.30m and cost_scaling_factor = 4.5.

diagnosed_limitations.title: Facility Spawn Orientation Traps
diagnosed_limitations.description: Baseline YAML start coordinates placed the robot facing away from doorways directly into walls or obstacles (Hospital facing bed, Loading facing perimeter wall, Room A facing back wall).
diagnosed_limitations.resolution: Resolved in V2.6 via empirical spawn alignment (Hospital center aisle yaw=1.57, Loading yaw=3.14, Room A yaw=-1.57).

diagnosed_limitations.title: Narrow Corridor Dynamic Obstacle Squeeze
diagnosed_limitations.description: In 1.2m corridors, opposite-moving dynamic carts require full robot stop-and-yield. If blockage exceeds 2.0s, alternative topological reroute is engaged.
diagnosed_limitations.resolution: Operational safety preserved via safe TTC yielding; recommend creep-forward protocol for future V2.7.
